target.description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_bre_w0.md, section 7.1: self-extinction of a flame over a porous burner by radiation as it grows by diffusion. Time origin: ignition. Derived case inputs (burner_mass_flux, is_methane, stated_time and the renamed conditions) are written by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py. (PhaseEndTime is the first target with a shared quantity); targets: flame_end, lasts, height_at_end
excludes: bre:lasts (binary): lane-local target, not a shared quantity
bre:height_at_end (positive, m): lane-local target, not a shared quantity

features.name: burner_diameter
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.burner_diameter.centre) / x.burner_diameter.scale; refused unless x.burner_diameter.lo <= x <= x.burner_diameter.hi @1

features.name: burner_mass_flux
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.burner_mass_flux.centre) / x.burner_mass_flux.scale; refused unless x.burner_mass_flux.lo <= x <= x.burner_mass_flux.hi @1

features.name: x_o2
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.x_o2.centre) / x.x_o2.scale; refused unless x.x_o2.lo <= x <= x.x_o2.hi @1

features.name: pressure
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.pressure.centre) / x.pressure.scale; refused unless x.pressure.lo <= x <= x.pressure.hi @1

features.name: x_fuel
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.x_fuel.centre) / x.x_fuel.scale; refused unless x.x_fuel.lo <= x <= x.x_fuel.hi @1

features.name: is_methane
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_methane.centre) / x.is_methane.scale; refused unless x.is_methane.lo <= x <= x.is_methane.hi @1

features.name: stated_time
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.stated_time.centre) / x.stated_time.scale; refused unless x.stated_time.lo <= x <= x.stated_time.hi @1

tensors.name: flame_end.extinction.median.b0
tensors.description: Value of ln(median time of cause extinction of flame_end alone / 1 s), since the time origin at z = 0 before hinge terms (ln(s)).

tensors.name: flame_end.extinction.median.skip
tensors.description: Linear weights of ln(median time of cause extinction of flame_end alone / 1 s), since the time origin on z, in feature order; every element is stated.

tensors.name: flame_end.extinction.median.W1

tensors.name: height_at_end.spread.b0

tensors.name: height_at_end.spread.skip
tensors.description: Linear weights of the ln-sd of the core component of height_at_end on z, in feature order; every element is stated.

tensors.name: height_at_end.spread.W1
tensors.description: Hinge input weights of the ln-sd of the core component of height_at_end; row j reads z in feature order.

tensors.name: height_at_end.spread.b1
tensors.description: Hinge biases of the ln-sd of the core component of height_at_end (hinge positions).

tensors.name: height_at_end.spread.w2
tensors.description: Hinge output weights of the ln-sd of the core component of height_at_end.

tensors.name: height_at_end.tail_weight
tensors.description: Weight of the wider component of height_at_end (0: one log-normal).

tensors.name: height_at_end.tail_width
tensors.description: ln-sd of the wider component of height_at_end over that of the core (1: no wider component).

tensors.name: num.substeps
tensors.description: Integration steps per requested interval of an event target (numerical, not physics).

notes: Generic law forward law.rs, declaration configs/models/law/bre/decl.json (status Declared): {"slug":"bre","status":"declared","family":"other","investigation":"PSI-20, ACME Burning Rate Emulator (BRE): porous-disc burner of 25 or 50 mm in a quiescent microgravity chamber","description":"W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_bre_w0.md, section 7.1: self-extinction of a flame over a porous burner by radiation as it grows by diffusion. Time origin: ignition. Derived case inputs (burner_mass_flux, is_methane, stated_time and the renamed conditions) are written by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py.","features":[{"name":"burner_diameter","unit":"m","transform":"ln","description":"diameter of the porous face (0.025 or 0.050)"},{"name":"burner_mass_flux","unit":"kg/m2/s","transform":"ln","description":"mass flow of the burner gas (fuel plus its nitrogen) at the first setpoint, per unit face area"},{"name":"x_o2","unit":"1","transform":"ln","description":"oxygen mole fraction of the chamber gas just before ignition"},{"name":"pressure","unit":"Pa","transform":"ln","description":"chamber pressure just before ignition"},{"name":"x_fuel","unit":"1","transform":"ln","description":"fuel mole fraction of the burner gas (1 for a pure fuel, 0.5 for the 50 % bottle)"},{"name":"is_methane","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"1 for methane, 0 for ethylene"},{"name":"stated_time","unit":"s","transform":"ln","description":"the time asked about by lasts; any admissible value for the other targets, which give it no weight"}],"targets":[{"name":"flame_end","kind":"event","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":["extinction"],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"the flame goes out by itself while the fuel flow is still at its first setpoint, seconds since ignition; no scheduled_stop condition (a stop comes from known_controls when one is known)"},{"name":"lasts","kind":"binary","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"the flame is still burning stated_time seconds after ignition, flow unchanged"},{"name":"height_at_end","kind":"positive","unit":"m","shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"height of the flame above the burner centre in the last second before self-extinction (lane-local)"}]}. Each network is N(z) = b0 + skip . z + sum_j w2[j] relu(b1[j] + W1[j, :] . z). A positive target is a mixture of two log-normals of one median exp(N_median), ln-sds N_spread and tail_width * N_spread, weights 1 - tail_weight and tail_weight; a non-positive spread is refused. A binary target is logistic(N_logit). An event target is the competition of log-logistic clocks exp(N_c), shape c.shape, conditioned on no event before the cutoff; the earliest control stage scheduled_stop or flow_stop, and the declared stop condition plus each offset node with a positive weight, take the active mass. Lane-local targets are labelled <slug>:<target> in diagnostics.law and carry no shared quantity. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
